# ToolStackReview

> Independent, in-depth reviews and comparisons of AI tools, SaaS platforms, and business software for small businesses and entrepreneurs. Hands-on testing of 60+ tools with real accounts.

## About

ToolStackReview is founded by Dave Hassell and provides honest, research-backed reviews of digital tools and software. Every tool is tested hands-on with real accounts before being reviewed. The site covers AI writing tools, email marketing platforms, SEO software, VPN services, website builders, landing page builders, CRMs, e-commerce platforms, accounting software, and more.

- Author: Dave Hassell
- Contact: dave.hassell@mac.com
- Site: https://marketingamp.github.io
